objective: Define affordance lookup and target ambiguity contract
acceptance: The named outcome has actual source/build-bound evidence; unsupported, pending, failed and unperformed checks remain explicit.

decision.canonical_entity: Existing WorldEntity identities and complete canonical snapshots; entity definitions cover NPC, object, location, creature, faction and environmental system without inferred mechanics.
decision.lookup: World validates native source-admitted action/actor/current target records against complete basis/pins and exact content/rule inventory. Empty supported mechanics remains NeedsRuling.
decision.ambiguity: Intent resolves only one exact source-admitted binding or an explicit eligible typed identity. More than one eligible target yields sorted NeedsClarification candidates; no first-label/order/confidence choice.
decision.unsupported: Explicit identity outside current eligible bindings is UnsupportedTarget. Unsupported mechanics remain NeedsRuling. Mixed targeted/untargeted policies and conflicting same-target sources are refused.
decision.native: Current authored Journey offers produce canonical bindings; offered and stage consume World+Intent before existing registered compiled JourneyHandler. Courier/Bandit/self use existing canonical IDs; no new action, physics, authority or entity minted.
decision.authority: Native ownership admits eligible source records; catalog membership alone is insufficient. Existing Rules handler revalidates mechanics and Session owns durable commitment.

alternatives.outcome: Canonical typed source-admitted lookup, exact target resolution, current native producer/consumer.
Model text, labels, catalog presence, confidence or first collection position authorizes generic mechanics or silently chooses ambiguity.
Additional entity actions require actual source-approved native admission and compiled mechanics; unavailable combinations remain NeedsRuling.

bounds.inputs: Explicit positive owner limits; typed capacity/allocation failure without partial output.

unsupported: No general physics or unadmitted object mechanics
No raw dialogue inference; D02 owns finality/confirmation producer
No browser target-selection UI/RPC schema, live provider, physical-device or complete 2024 catalog claim
